John Hopfield era físico, y eso explica: John Hopfield was a physicist, and that explains the whole topic: he carried over to neurons the mathematics of spin glasses, materials whose atoms have magnetic orientations that interact in pairs and seek to minimise an energy. His 1982 paper had a disproportionate effect: it arrived in the middle of the neural network desert, it brought a mathematical guarantee of convergence — something very scarce then — and it drew a generation of physicists into the field. In 2024 he shared the Nobel Prize in Physics with Geoffrey Hinton, for the work that made machine learning with neural networks possible.
